description: Rolling window statistics (mean/std/min/max/sum) for an indicator. Smooths noise, reveals trends | use it before claiming a turning point in a monthly FRED or Eurostat series. Runs on any verified autario indicator (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, IMF, WHO, ECB, US Census, SEC).

full.description: Return the full raw time series (heavy, many tokens). Default false → you get only the summary/stats, which is enough to ANSWER a question. Set true only when you must plot or export every point.

name: rolling_stats
